assets.prompt: Shrine of the Ash-Choked Saint: A soot-blackened reliquary leans against a dead oak. Inside, a saint's skull still wears a crown of tarnished silver, and the air tastes of old smoke.
Column of the Dispossessed: Carts piled with bedding, grandmothers, a goat. Burned-out villagers trudge west, away from the red sky. Their eyes go to your banners, then to the ground.
Overturned Supply Wagon: A quartermaster's wagon lies on its side, axle snapped, oxen gone. Crates are still lashed to the bed. The mud around it is churned by too many paws.
The Blind Cartographer: An old man with milk-white eyes sits among rolled maps, inking coastlines by touch. 'I remember every road,' he says, 'for a price.'
Free Company Encampment: Tents patched with captured banners. Slingers dice around a fire while their captain, a scarred woman with one ear, sizes up your army.
The Drowned Chapel: Only the bell tower rises from the black water. Something silver glints in the drowned nave, and the reeds whisper with no wind.
Field of Unquiet Barrows: Grave mounds in rows too straight to be natural, each capped with a rusted helm. The ground is cold even under the sun.
Champion of the Ash Pit: A fighting pit ringed with spikes and cheering wretches. Its champion, a hulking brute in a branded iron mask, beats his chest at you.
Ember Rift: The ground splits into a glowing seam. Things with too many joints crawl at its lip, and the brimstone stink makes the horses scream.
Thornwolf Den: Bones and bramble mark the mouth of a hollow under the roots. Yellow eyes watch from the dark; the pack has not decided what you are.
Brigand Toll: A chain across the bridge, a brazier and a dozen slingers on the far bank. 'Road's ours,' their leader calls. 'Pay up or swim.'
The Dying Courier: A rider slumped against a milestone, an arrow through his side and a sealed satchel clutched to his chest. 'The pass at Harrowgate,' he whispers. 'They must know.'
Hall of Echoes: A roofless hall where every carved word is repeated back a heartbeat late. Generations of commanders have cut their lessons into its walls.
The Lockstone: ancient massive metal-bound stone seal with dwarf-forged brass clamps and huge severed root braces, an ominous thin ember crack, compact monument
Saint Orrin's Rest: ruined Concord chapel yard with Wren tower heraldry, a hanging iron cage and cold green grave lights, half sunken flagstones
Elderwold: cluster of gigantic felled ancient tree stumps and cut root buttresses, dead thorn and moss, hollow roots faintly glowing
